saw_lines: Gift buyers choose a hamper for a birthday or thank you, then need one reason to trust a stranger’s box before they pay.
So the sale is won in the ad itself, where a buyer with no proof number scrolls past to a competitor.
Your 11 copy ads carry no proof number, so collect one review count or orders shipped and open the next batch with it on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 18 Oct 2026
points: None of your 11 copy ads shows a number like a review count or orders shipped, so a new gift buyer has nothing to trust before clicking. Collect one proof number and open the next batch with it on the creative.

Your 11 copy ads use 9 different openings, so no single hook gets enough repetition to show what works. Two openers lead two ads each and the rest get one. Pick the two strongest and build three variations of each.
Two ads have run 60+ days, which is evidence they hold up. Keep both live and build three variations of the older one, changing the first line and the shot, so the idea gets tested again.

All 12 ads use the same Shop now button, sending buyers to seven different landing pages with no timing cue. Swap two buttons to Order by 4pm, which matches your next-day delivery promise, and match each button to its page.

ads_1: Gift-hamper openers rebuilt around one proof number and the delivery promise
